title: GSD X Mission Obligations
description: Holds wave completion while a derived mission obligation is still open. The obligations, the contract projection and the closure receipt are owned by modules/gsd_x/mission; this manifest is only the registration that makes them reachable from a real GSD run.

notes.claude: The only runtime installed on the host this was proven against (.gsd-runtime = claude). Other runtimes are left unlisted rather than declared unsupported, because nothing here has been measured against them.

enabled.description: Hold a wave while a derived mission obligation is still open. Off by default: capability install writes to the runtime config dir, so this gate is visible to every GSD project on the host, and it fails closed (onError: halt) once switched on.
